certification.name: Certified Data Management Professional
certification.description: Data management certification aligned with the DAMA-DMBOK, offered at Associate, Practitioner and Master levels. Each online exam has 100 multiple-choice questions in 90 minutes; the pass mark on the Fundamentals exam is 60% for Associate, 70% for Practitioner and 80% for Master.
certification.currency_note: Per exam; Associate level needs 1 exam (Data Management Fundamentals), Practitioner and Master need 3
